meta.title: Device RKP Issuer
meta.description: Sign a P-256 key with this device's KeyMint TA and get an RKP certificate chain from Google, exported as keybox.xml.
meta.warning: This only works on some devices and only issues RKP certificates. Native methods use a private Qualcomm KeyMint ABI that may differ across firmware. MediaTek devices use only the V1 AIDL bridge; firmware compatibility and server acceptance remain unverified. An incompatible ABI can crash the worker or trusted app. The exported keybox contains a software-generated private key; keep the files private. Read the prerequisites before continuing.

limitations.partial_device_support: Only some devices work. V1 AIDL requires app_process and the device’s RKP AIDL APK. V2 requires /dev/smcinvoke and libkeymasterdeviceutils.so. V1 AIDL: PureSoft HBK=0. Native V1 is also tried by automatic mode after the other available methods fail.
limitations.rkp_only: Only RKP certificates can be issued. A compatible device is required to obtain the signed CSR. The exported private key is generated in software; no private key is extracted from the TEE.

status.title: Prerequisites

confirm.title: Send a request to the KeyMint TA?
confirm.body: This runs RKP (V1 / V2) on the device's KeyMint trusted app and submits the result to Google. It only works on some devices and only RKP certificates can be issued. The exported files contain a private key; keep them private. Continue?

renewal.title: Automatic RKP renewal (local build)
renewal.description: TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint · local check every 6 hours · renew with 24 hours remaining · off by default
renewal.unsupported: Requires one active supported backend: TEESimulator code ≥ 75 (one default patch profile, keybox.xml), or ITxiao6666/OhMyKeymint code ≥ 222 (fixed keybox.xml), and a locally verifiable Google-rooted P-256 Keybox. Confirm enable again after migration.
renewal.pausedDescription: Check the status and certificate files first. A request with an unknown result must not be repeated blindly. The old working file is retained whenever rollback is possible.
renewal.privacy: Expiry checks are offline. Only a due renewal or a pending new certificate uses the network. The CSR contains public provisioning data; the Keybox private key stays on this device. Cleanup touches only unchanged, expired files created by this renewal feature. Module load confirmation does not verify a Play Integrity verdict.
renewal.protocol: Use the protocol that already issued successfully on this phone
renewal.consent: Enable future Google RKP requests using the selected protocol when the chain has 24 hours or less remaining? Checks run about every 6 hours while Android is running. At most two attempts per rolling 24 hours; ordinary expiry checks are offline. This calls the same vendor KeyMint interface as manual issuance, whose compatibility depends on firmware. New files are verified, backed up and applied to TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint with load confirmation and rollback. This local build has not completed a live automatic issuance test.
renewal.resumeConsent: Only continue after checking whether the previous request produced a certificate. Resuming after a timeout or crash may allow another request; Google may have accepted the earlier one. Existing cooldowns and request counts remain in force. A pending certificate is reused instead of signing again. After clock correction, wait at least 24 hours; request counts are retained.

renewal.protocolHelp: Choose an interface and save it for the next renewal. Saving does not issue a certificate or change the renewal switch. Changes are locked while a certificate is being processed.
renewal.discardConfirm: Keep the current certificate and request cooldown. Candidate files are cleaned only after expiry if unchanged.

diagnostics.operation_busy: Another operation is running; retry later
diagnostics.storage_io_failed: File I/O failed; check storage and access
diagnostics.backend_changed: Old backend has pending work; resolve it before changing backends

renewal.recoverConfirm: Restore the previous file without enabling renewal or contacting a certificate server. If there was no previous file, its absence is restored and runtime state still needs checking.
renewal.omkConsent: OhMyKeymint: replacing the Keybox retires some attestation keys bound to the previous identity; affected apps may need enrollment again. File rollback cannot restore retired app keys. Load evidence uses fresh watcher logs with stable file, configuration and process identity; it is not a Play Integrity verdict. Accept and enable?
